notes.title: DEVLOG#2
notes.content:
Welcome to the Archery RED devlog!

Today's topic is opponents. Designing interesting opponents was a difficult challenge for us. They couldn't be too strong, after all we need to have some way of defending ourselves against them but they couldn't be too weak either, because if the game doesn't provide us with a challenge we'll get bored very quickly :)  I would like to introduce you to all the opponents in Archery RED!

Shield - yes, you see correctly, the shield, the basic opponent in the game and one of the first we created, was not grandiose at first, but after a lot of polishing (really a lot!) it looks amazing especially its effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/b1e0978f8f61089b12dad6d8f570757cdf41a277.gif

The opponent with the bow - this was another opponent we designed. At the beginning his only task was to stand and shoot at us. However, that wasn't enough, so he was given the ability to move in between attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/95ddf6f45a7a5ea67aa4c90477320fc2e55c92a2.gif

The next opponent is the armoured archer. As the name suggests, it's more robust, and has another feature - it fires a series of energy projectiles. Sounds good, but you'll have to work hard to dodge them :D 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/9c9607d205dd61ce201e46963706e4b799672195.gif

Headless - a powerful opponent. At first glance, he behaves like his predecessors, but shoots at us with a rapid series of energy bullets, and after destroying his body, his head becomes an autonomous entity that approaches us while shooting at the same time. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/ba2c0d75234aaa217ef118cab4abff84c309cde4.gif

Another enemy is the drone - a flying entity holding shields, it is more mobile than the rest and takes a long time to charge its attack ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/624ee6a2880d03d02ae3cc7195f28d34929cf75c.gif

Kamikaze - A dangerous opponent. If you don't see him in time it may be too late! The closer he is to us, the faster he moves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/5cea06e70573a5f033830919cc2135f161afae51.gif

And that's it for today! Share your thoughts with us and let us know how you liked it. I invite you to the next devlog soon.

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
A warm welcome to all of you to our first devlog of the game Archery RED! 

We are a small team that wanted to create something different from what we've done so far and that's how we got interested in virtual reality. We are big fans of archery and we wanted to try to transfer this feeling, which no other platform would give us. Therefore, we present our first virtual reality project: Archery Red!

In these devlogs we would like to share with you how the development of the game went and what difficulties we encountered.

Where did we start?

We created a character with a bow and then the first harmless opponent.

This was the stage when we asked ourselves an important question: what is the most convenient way to shoot an arrow that will appeal to everyone? How to deploy the UI to comfortably peek at the statistics in the game? You can see the beginnings in the gif below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/37c7b86545c4024575aecc286101a2ea74792cc0.gif

The bow and shooting feel was very basic, but also we were looking for the perfect look and here we found it! It looks so much better and more professional doesn't it? :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/2d66937f8d01b176ad5dd0489dd889d71c1c36d3.gif

We then tried to find a way to indicate to the player what range of shot he had. This is what our first attempt looked like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/bebbccd8a30db223753c9543cda057077c9b6c24.gif

We later noticed that the visibility of the arrow was very poor - we had to change that. The first iteration of the trail behind the arrow was very visible but this is not really what we wanted to achieve ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/c66ab0839f36a82eb34c354b9406d0fecf3f2bff.gif

Much better ! By the way, we added a new bow colour and you can see where the arrow hits :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/206d825989a88460406664f6a2470fbddaaaf059.gif

A little extra polish to the look of the bow, From now on the arrow appears on the bow in a nice animation

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/cd2da495fb6bbc82416d85fc440e46e77a1d054e.gif

And there you have it, our bow in its final form, it's beautiful, we can see the arrows in flight and we can see where we hit :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698169/39a36e77e136898a42d881eaecbc0e73fcacdd38.gif

And here we are, we look forward to your comments and feedback and see you in the next devlog !
